title: Nanoporous ZnO/SiO2 aerogel and xerogel composites via a one-pot sol–gel process at room temperature
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,39566-39577
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05345E, Paper
Open Access

Al-Zahraa Fatima El-Cheikh, Witold Kwapinski, Mohammad N. Ahmad, James J. Leahy, Houssam El-Rassy
A series of nanoporous ZnO/SiO2 aerogels and xerogels were synthesized via an epoxide-assisted sol–gel route, aimed at producing zinc-rich composite materials with tunable properties.
